arabic text: RONAY KO TERE GHAM ME TARASTI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: Within your homeland, Fatima remains alone, Baba; Fatima longs even for permission to weep over your grief.

arabic text: BABA MUJHE WATAN ME GHAREEBUL WATAN KIYA\nRONE PE KALMA GOYON NE PEHRA LAGA DIYA\nAPNE MAKAA'N ME REHKE BHI QAIDI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: Baba, they made me a stranger within my own homeland;\nthose who recite the kalima placed guards over my weeping.\nEven inside her own home, Fatima remains a prisoner.

arabic text: ARSA HUWA KE MADAR E ZAINAB GUZARGAYI\nDARBAAR JAAKE AAPKI BETI TO MARGAYI\nDUNYA SAMAJH RAHI HAI KE JEETI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: It has been so long since Zainab's mother passed away;\nyour daughter died the day she entered the court.\nThe world assumes Fatima is still alive.

arabic text: PEHLE SALAAM SE KIYA LOGO NE IJTINAB\nAB YEH SALAAM KARTE HAI DETE NAHI JAWAB\nHAR DAM ALI KE GHAM ME TARAPTI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: First, people stopped offering salam;\nnow when they do, they refuse to answer it.\nFatima writhes constantly over Ali's grief.

arabic text: TAKBEER KIS TARHA KAHU'N KAISE DUA KARU\nPEHLU SE HAATH UTHTA NAHI'N HAI ME KYA KARU\nTASBEEH BAAEIN HAATH SE PARHTI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: How can I say the takbir, and how can I raise my hands in prayer?\nMy hand cannot lift from my wounded side—what can I do?\nFatima recites the tasbih with her left hand.

arabic text: SOTA HAI WOH SHAHEED E WILAYAT MERA YAHAN\nPEHLU NAHI HAI QABR HAI MOHSIN KI BABAJA'N\nKARWAT YEH SOCH KAR NAHI LETI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: The martyr of wilayah, my son, sleeps here;\nthis is not merely my side—it is Mohsin's grave, Baba.\nThinking of this, Fatima does not turn upon her side.

arabic text: DARBAR E SHAM SOCH KE ROTI HON HAR GHARI\nZAINAB KO PYAAR KARTI HON KULSOOM KO KABHI\nDARBAR SE JO LAUT KE AAYI HAI FATEMA
english translation text: I weep at every moment when I imagine the court of Shaam;\nat times I embrace Zainab, and at times Kulsum.\nFatima has returned from the court.

arabic text:
KAISE BATAWON MEER TAKALLUM ME DIL KA HAAL
JAB QABR E FATEMA KI TARAF JATA HAI KHAYAL
LAGTA HAI JAISE DHOOP ME BAITHI HAI FATEMA
SHAL
english translation text:
O "Mir Taqallum", how can I express
the condition of my heart? Whenever I
think of Fatima's grave, it seems as
though Fatima sits beneath the burning sun.
